inspectionEvidence.summary: Callflow candidate DTO in src/lib/callflow-dto.ts lacks third-party booking marketplace metadata and URLs present in domain models and CSV export, causing leads in target niches (peluquerías/barberías) to lose critical digital maturity and channel gap signals during Callflow handoff.
